sourceCut.limitation: This is the stable pre-UI-correction source cut. UI, workflow, and allowlist changes made after the run require later evidence. Current working files are not required to equal this preserved cut.

summary.reporterInterpretation: JSON suite counts include nested suites, not just test files. JSON file status calls four all-skipped files passed; recomputed file outcomes agree with the console summary.

observations.linuxContractInterpretation: The owning Linux guard requires a verified inherited broker/kernel custody boundary and rejects unsupported leaf, readOnly, tree, empty and Git-metadata import requests. observations.desktopErrorLimit: nextMessage deliberately replaces harness.error details with a generic lifecycle error, so these retained failures do not establish missing assets or a particular native cause.

failureGroups.interpretation: Observed file-access refusal text. Direct Linux-guard stack traces are counted separately. This is not a blanket attribution of all failures to the platform.
